8-9-24
The policyholder's driver reported a low-speed head-on collision in a parking area and described neck pain at the
scene. The driver is named on the policy, and the claimant is not represented by a lawyer.
8-10-24
The police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the impact. No independent witnesses have
been identified, so the file relies on the parties' accounts and the police findings.
8-22-24
Photos taken at inspection show some details of the collision. The vehicle damage is mostly in line with the described
impact, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records.
9-3-24
A neighbor mentioned seeing the car with damage some weeks before the reported loss. I have noted this statement
and will follow up to verify it.
10-12-24
The claimant added a few small detials in a recorded follow-up call, but the core account has stayed the same since
the first report.
11-14-24
The claimant's neck strain is consistent with the kind and force of the crash. Treatment followed a usual course, and
no eralier injury to the same body area is known.
3-13-25
Treatment tapered off as the claimant improved. The file is being reviewed pending final medical notes and the
outcome of the neighbor follow-up.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
